//: The composite index the Home Feed query needs (Day 6).
ListingRepository.availableListings() filters on `status` and orders by `createdAt`.
Firestore creates single-field indexes automatically, but an equality filter on one field
combined with an ordering on a different field can only be served by a composite index, and
that one has to be asked for. Until it exists the query fails with FAILED_PRECONDITION and
the feed shows an error rather than listings.
The easy way to create it is the console link Firestore prints in Logcat alongside that
error - it arrives pre-filled. This file is the same index written down, so it is part of
the repo rather than a click someone has to remember, and so `firebase deploy --only
firestore:indexes` can recreate it against a fresh project. See README 'Setup'.
